title.zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen：面向智能体工作流的快速模型
title.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: A Faster Model for Agent Workflows

excerpt.zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 主打速度、效率与日常智能体执行，可独立处理常见任务，也能与更强推理模型协作；实际表现仍需结合具体工作流评估。
excerpt.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen targets fast, efficient execution for everyday agent workflows and can work alone or alongside deeper-reasoning models. Its practical value still depends on the task.

disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 是 Google 推出的快速执行型模型，面向日常编码和智能体工作流。它既可单独处理常见任务，也可与 Gemini 4 Carbon、Argon 等模型配合，把复杂推理与高频执行分开。
text.en: Google positions Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast execution model for everyday coding and agent workflows. It can handle routine tasks on its own or work alongside Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon, separating deeper reasoning from frequent execution.

text.zh: Google 表示，Hydrogen 在默认高思考级别的 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 得分为 51，高于 Argon 的 50；最高 xhigh 级别为 54。其 API 输入和输出价格分别为每百万 token 1.50 美元和 7.50 美元，覆盖整个一百万 token 上下文窗口。模型提供 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档思考级别，以权衡质量、延迟和成本。
text.en: Google says Hydrogen scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level, compared with 50 for Argon, and reaches 54 at xhigh. API pricing is $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens across the one-million-token context window. Four thinking levels—low, medium, high, and xhigh—let users trade off quality, latency, and cost.

text.zh: Google Antigravity 新增的 Orchestrator 可在同一会话中切换模型。Google 称，在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，它的任务成功率接近 Carbon，平均少用 24% 配额并快 19%。这一设计让较强模型负责协调或难题判断，Hydrogen 则承担执行、测试和验证。
text.en: Google Antigravity is adding Orchestrator, which can switch models within a session. Google reports that on Terminal-Bench 4.0 it achieved task success rates near Carbon while using 24% less quota on average and finishing 19% faster. The intended division is for a stronger model to coordinate or handle hard judgments while Hydrogen executes, tests, and verifies.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的适用场景与边界
text.en: Where Gemini 4 Hydrogen fits—and what remains unclear

text.zh: Hydrogen 也面向代码库调试、研究、数据分析和多模态文档处理。Google 报告称，它相较 Gemini 3.8 Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 得分超过三倍，并更快完成任务；模型可处理密集文档、表格、图表、音频和录制视频，生成带引用的结果。这些数字和演示来自 Google，不能直接代表所有真实场景。
text.en: Hydrogen is also aimed at repository debugging, research, data analysis, and multimodal document work. Google reports more than three times the Terminal-Bench 4.1 score and faster task completion compared with Gemini 3.8 Flash. It can process dense documents, spreadsheets, charts, audio, and recorded video to produce cited outputs. These figures and demonstrations come from Google and may not predict results in every real-world setting.

text.zh: Hydrogen 已面向 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini for business、Gemini 应用及 Google 搜索等渠道推出，部分 Antigravity 使用需付费订阅。对团队而言，关键问题不只是基准分数，而是路由策略能否在自己的任务中稳定减少等待和成本，同时不损害准确性；目前来源未提供独立验证或长期生产数据。
text.en: Hydrogen is rolling out through Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, and Google Search, with some Antigravity access requiring a paid subscription. For teams, the key question is not just benchmark performance: can model routing reliably reduce latency and cost on their own tasks without sacrificing accuracy? The source does not provide independent validation or long-term production results.
